content_text: [1/2 @gregoryblotnick] these three pages are what masterful biography look like, to me at least - on FDR (by HW Brands) what you see here is FDR at a pivotal point in his life, contemplating a third term or retirement, as well as what a man’s purpose is, the meaning of existence…some of it almost borders on philosophy but what HW Brands does exceptionally well here is turn a searching eye to all the facets of a man’s life - career, love, role models (Teddy Roosevelt), peers, one’s living legacy, and last, the steel gaze of posterity what makes it so good, is that all of this is highly relatable content…a series of dilemmas that anyone has either faced themselves, or can say with 100% certainty: “this is a juncture I will someday arrive at.” --- [2/2 @gregoryblotnick] been using this as a filtering mechanism for books also the great ones…ur gonna end up w/ lots of photos. say 15-20 total, or more —> gotta compile those notes, do an article, video…something, just out of respect to the author if nothing else.
